in_english.name: Widad
in_english.meaning: unwavering love, deep affection, profound attachment, profound love, deep devotion
in_english.long_meaning: Widad is a profound and unwavering love that encompasses deep affection, profound attachment, and deep devotion. In Arabic, the root of Widad (W-D-D) implies a strong, unshakeable bond between two individuals, whether it be between Allah and His creation or between two human beings. This concept is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition and is considered a fundamental aspect of the Islamic faith.
